","occurred_at":"2026-01-05T12:00:04-06:00","event_labels":[]},{"utterance_id":"1aaa92ddab6b4dc288d4821d1c2d8364","type":"utterance","utterance_text":"好呀，挨着你坐。","speaker":"assistant","session_id":"3:dialogue:4","occurred_at":"2026-01-05T12:00:05-06:00","event_labels":[]},{"utterance_id":"a884b8b642a3428790fc0d6aab84f786","type":"utterance","utterance_text":"刚忙完一阵，我们随便聊聊吧。","speaker":"user","session_id":"3:dialogue:5","occurred_at":"2026-01-05T13:00:00-06:00","event_labels":[]},{"utterance_id":"c1a44a776a664608a41d179fe9fe1e4a","type":"utterance","utterance_text":"相册里那张重画三次的草图没裁边，看得见橡皮擦过的印子才踏实。","speaker":"user","session_id":"3:dialogue:5","occurred_at":"2026-01-05T13:00:01-06:00","event_labels":[]},{"utterance_id":"ca73ba8ee6ba4b6b92d163af337aa74a","type":"utterance","utterance_text":"那只旅行带回的高花瓶独占了一层架子，我留这块空位留得甘愿。","speaker":"user","session_id":"3:dialogue:5","occurred_at":"2026-01-05T13:00:02-06:00","event_labels":[]},{"utterance_id":"e87d9f06e6be47f2ada4387718557d49","type":"utterance","utterance_text":"昨晚那幅填色没涂完，我又折了几张纸，来回换着倒很解乏。","speaker":"user","session_id":"3:dialogue:5","occurred_at":"2026-01-05T13:00:03-06:00","event_labels":[]},{"utterance_id":"abb153b573774ecf9e21e7930cf332a7","type":"utterance","utterance_text":"去年的鞋码没有变，我穿四十二号；下周租靴子时照这个来。","speaker":"user","session_id":"3:dialogue:5","occurred_at":"2026-01-05T13:00:04-06:00","event_labels":[]},{"utterance_id":"df24a927a1144366b76f91cb25c309f7","type":"utterance","utterance_text":"过两周想参加一次短住活动，眼前还有几个电话要回。","speaker":"user","session_id":"3:dialogue:5","occurred_at":"2026-01-05T13:00:05-06:00","event_labels":[]},{"utterance_id":"86d3761ed0d2406b8d50c738c1bfed40","type":"utterance","utterance_text":"我自己的床铺不用香味；客房来客指定淡淡木香。","speaker":"user","session_id":"3:dialogue:5","occurred_at":"2026-01-05T13:00:06-06:00","event_labels":[]},{"utterance_id":"3176fc1622a244c49a182e485713b13b","type":"utterance","utterance_text":"地图上的岛画完了，我们看看线条吧。","speaker":"user","session_id":"3:dialogue:5","occurred_at":"2026-01-05T13:00
